# SANCTUM
> SANCTUM is an unmatched moving sequence to empower the body and expand the mind — designed to unlock human potential by guiding you to your physical edge and mindful euphoria within a single class.

## Classes
- [London](https://www.wearesanctum.com/classes/london/): Sunday rituals in Marylebone, moon specials beneath the vaults of Holy Trinity Church and Sanctum & Sauna in Shoreditch.
- [Amsterdam](https://www.wearesanctum.com/classes/amsterdam/): Where Sanctum was born. Moon specials in historic synagogues and churches, and ADE nights at Clink.
- [Dubai](https://www.wearesanctum.com/classes/dubai/): Moon specials at SIRO, One Za’abeel and fully immersive projection classes at TODA.
- [Stockholm](https://www.wearesanctum.com/classes/stockholm/): Sunday Sanctum + Sauna by the water at Hagastrand.
- [New York](https://www.wearesanctum.com/classes/new-york/): Monday nights beneath the Byzantine domes of St Bartholomew’s Church, Manhattan.

## Experiences
- [Membership](https://www.wearesanctum.com/memberships/): 4 experiences per month, unlimited digital access, 2 guest passes, priority booking.
- [Sanctum Digital](https://www.wearesanctum.com/digital/): The first fully immersive digital platform blending sound, movement, mindfulness and spectacular locations.
- [Private bookings](https://www.wearesanctum.com/private-bookings/): Signature Sequence, Focus Energiser, Mindful Nature Walk, Bespoke Experience.
- [Frequency Festival](https://www.wearesanctum.com/frequency-festival/): Sanctum amplified: a large-scale moving ritual where thousands move, breathe and release together inside iconic spaces charged with music, light and emotion.
- [Events & retreats](https://www.wearesanctum.com/events-retreats/)
